The '''Panteer Refuge''' was a small hideout owned by [[House Panteer]] and located on the west end of the [[Glarus Valley]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], along the northern edge. In this refuge were stationed [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Bradel]] and [[Katei Elinari Panteer]].
